The pattern-equality test `test_clarify_q_count_patterns_stay_consistent_for_blockquotes`, its helper `_extract_clarify_q_count_patterns`, and the `CLARIFY_WF` constant — all present in the original PR diff — are absent from `tests/test_plan_auto_answer_recommended_parser.py`.   WHY: A model emission whose Q-ID line lacks a trailing colon would be counted by the behavioral parser (line 1076, setting `needs_clarification=true`) but reported as zero in the step summary (line 1029), producing a misleading job-summary row. More critically, the absence of the pattern-equality test means any future edit can silently widen the divergence without any CI signal.
